jobs_results.title: Hiring: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Company Description D2N Solutions is a talent and solutions provider that helps organizations build high-performing teams aligned with their culture and business goals. The company brings together experienced staffing, recruitment, compliance, finance, and marketing professionals who understand the challenges facing both clients and candidates in today’s employment market. D2N Solutions offers comprehensive support across a wide range of technology services, including artificial intelligence, information security, cloud computing, big data, and enterprise applications.


The organization also delivers technology infrastructure services such as data centers, networks, security services, and IT help desk support. In addition, D2N Solutions provides business consulting services across multiple industries, including banking, financial services, healthcare, education, retail, and telecom.


Role Description This is a full-time remote role for a Data Analyst at D2N Solutions.


The Data
Analyst will collect, clean, and organize data from various sources to support business decisions and client projects. The role involves performing data analysis, building reports and dashboards, and applying statistical methods to identify trends, patterns, and insights.


The Data
Analyst will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business questions into analytical tasks, document findings, and present clear, actionable recommendations. The position also includes maintaining data quality, supporting data modeling efforts, and contributing to process improvements and best practices in data management.


Qualifications
 

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and proven experience in Data Analytics.Candidates should possess a solid foundation in Statistics and the ability to apply statistical methods to real-world data.Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, including the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.Candidates should possess experience in Data Modeling and working with structured and unstructured datasets.Experience with data visualization tools (e.G., Power BI, Tableau, or similar) and SQL or other query languages is beneficial.Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline is preferred.Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate with distributed teams.Familiarity with programming languages used in data analysis (e.G., Python or R) and experience in consulting or client-facing roles are a plus.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst (Fresher / Trainee)
jobs_results.description:
Applications are open for the Data Analyst (Fresher / Trainee) position at boldfit in Dehradun. You will join a working data analytics team, own a defined set of reports and analyses end to end, and see your findings turn into decisions that people act on.

About the role
As a Data Analyst (Fresher / Trainee) at boldfit, your core responsibility is learning the analytics stack on live business data under a senior analyst. You will work in Excel, SQL and Power BI every day, partner with business stakeholders to understand what they actually need, and deliver analysis that is accurate, reproducible and easy to act on.

Key responsibilities
• Prepare and clean datasets for the analytics team
• Build simple dashboards and recurring reports under review
• Run first-pass analyses and summarise what you found
• Cross-check numbers against source systems
• Document your queries and steps so others can repeat them
• Validate and reconcile numbers before they are published, and document known data caveats
• Automate recurring reporting so the team spends its time on analysis rather than refreshes
• Present findings to non-technical stakeholders in clear, plain language

Required skills and tools
• SQL Basics
• Advanced Excel
• Power BI
• Data Cleaning
• Descriptive Statistics
• Data Visualization
• Python Basics
• Reporting
• Attention to Detail
• Analytical Thinking
• Communication
• Time Management

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc/B.Com/BBA — 2024–2026 batches. Candidates from any recognised university are welcome.
• Graduation year: 2023–2026 batches. Freshers and final-year students awaiting results may apply.
• Minimum 60% / 6.0 CGPA in the highest qualification (indicative — strong practical skills can offset this).
• Experience: 0–1 years in analytics, reporting, MIS or a closely related function.
• Technical skills: SQL Basics, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Data Cleaning, Descriptive Statistics, Data Visualization.
• Soft skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, stakeholder communication, ownership and the confidence to flag a number that looks wrong.

Salary and compensation
• Annual CTC: ₹2,40,000 – ₹4,60,000 per year (2.4 LPA – 4.6 LPA), an indicative market range for this role in Dehradun.
• Monthly equivalent: approximately ₹29,000 per month at the mid-point of the range.
• Currency: INR (₹).
• Performance bonus / variable pay as per boldfit's policy, reviewed annually.
• The exact offer is confirmed by boldfit based on your interview performance and current compensation.

Perks and benefits
• Structured onboarding and mentorship
• Learning & certification support (SQL, Power BI, Tableau, cloud)
• Paid leaves and public holidays
• Flexible / hybrid working options
• Modern analytics tooling and licensed BI seats
• Clear appraisal cycle and internal mobility
• Employee wellness programmes
• Team offsites and networking opportunities

Location, work mode and employment type
• Location: Dehradun, Uttarakhand
• Work mode: Work From Office
• Employment type: Full-time, permanent
• Working hours: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, Monday to Friday
• Number of openings: 4
• Joining: immediate to 60 days, as per your notice period

Selection process
• Round 1 — Resume screening and profile shortlisting by the talent acquisition team
• Round 2 — Business / stakeholder round — how you scope a question and communicate findings
• Round 3 — Hiring manager discussion — role expectations, ownership and team fit
• Round 4 — HR discussion — compensation, notice period, joining date and offer roll-out

Who should apply
Candidates from B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc/B.Com/BBA — 2024–2026 batches with up to 1 years of relevant experience who are based in Dehradun or willing to relocate. You should be comfortable with SQL Basics, Advanced Excel, Power BI and able to explain your analysis to someone who has never seen the data. Portfolio projects, Kaggle work, a GitHub repo or published dashboards strengthen an application, especially for early-career candidates.

Why join boldfit
boldfit gives analysts real ownership rather than ticket queues. You are close to the decision-makers, your recommendations are heard, and good work is visible. High performers move into senior and lead analyst roles, take ownership of a business vertical, or specialise in data science, data engineering or product analytics. You will leave every year of this role with the first real analytics experience on your CV.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst, Digital Thread - India (Dehradun)
jobs_results.description:
Are you passionate about transforming data into meaningful business solutions? Do you enjoy collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders to solve complex challenges?

If so, we have an opportunity for you! The Gateway team is looking for a Data Analyst to help build and evolve the data ecosystem supporting InnovMetric's Digital Thread strategy. In this role, you will create data solutions, dashboards, integrations, and API-driven tools that make key data accessible to internal teams, partners, and customers.

You will work in an Agile environment with global colleagues and technology partners to clarify data needs and deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.

Responsibilities 

More specifically, your main responsibilities will be to:

- Collaborate with internal stakeholders, technology partners, and customers to understand data enablement requirements and validate proposed solutions
- Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and data integration solutions that support Digital Thread initiatives
- Build and leverage API-based integrations to extract, transform, and expose dimensional and operational data
- Develop reusable and scalable data solutions that facilitate data accessibility and decision-making
- Ensure the quality, reliability, and documentation of developed tools before production deployment
- Participate in testing, delivery, and continuous improvement activities
- Contribute to Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily scrums, and retrospectives
- Perform other related tasks supporting the evolution of InnovMetric's Digital Thread ecosystem

Qualifications

- Have 2 to 3 years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data integration 
- Demonstrate hands-on experience with designing dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Excel 
- Demonstrate solid understanding of data transformation and modeling concepts, including Power Query and DAX 
- Have experience working with REST APIs and integrating data from multiple sources
- Demonstrate proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python and/or C#
- Be familiar with third-party manufacturing, quality, or enterprise data analysis tools (an asset) 
- Demonstrate solid collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to share information effectively across digital platforms 
- Show autonomy, initiative and resourcefulness 
- Exhibit strong organizational skills and attention to detail 
- Be fluent in written and spoken English

We thank you for your interest in this position. Please note that we will only contact shortlisted candidates. 

Who are we?

PolyWorks India empowers manufacturers of every size to digitally transform their 3D measurement processes and maximize the value of 3D measurement data for their product engineering and manufacturing processes. Located in Pune, Maharashtra, PolyWorks India provides PolyWorks® smart 3D metrology software solutions and technical services–including technical support, training, metrology process consulting, and software customization–to industrial manufacturers in India.

PolyWorks India is an InnovMetric group company, a multinational software development organization headquartered in Canada with over 700 employees dedicated to bringing 3D measurement data at the heart of enterprise manufacturing processes.

jobs_results.description:
Data Analyst - Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Operations & Infrastructure   
Role: Data Analyst – AV Support Data Infrastructure & Analytics   
Experience: 4–6 Years   
Location: Remote / Adaptable   
Industry: Global Tech & Mobility Leader   
About the Team & Chance   
Our team owns the end-to-end data foundation driving autonomous vehicle (AV) support operations for one of the world's leading mobility platforms. Every operational metric, real-time rider contact, automated data-quality check, and pre-launch feature instrumentation flows through the systems we architect.   
We sit directly at the intersection of AV Program Teams , Operational Analytics , and Core Data Engineering to turn complex operational data into actionable, trustworthy insights.   

What You’ll Do   
Redefine the Core Data Layer: Transform organically grown data environments into a deliberate, clean \"gold layer.\" Consolidate overlapping tables, optimize upstream join logic, and establish unified canonical datasets.   
Deliver Business Analytics & Insights: Partner with AV program leadership to scope ambiguous business challenges, define metrics, build dashboards, and answer high-impact operational questions.   
Guide Instrumentation for Recent AV Products: Review Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) across launch lifecycles to ensure proper event logging and telemetry are live before new features ship.   
Maintain & Govern Data Infrastructure: Monitor daily pipelines for freshness, accuracy, and volume. Build governance frameworks around SLAs, change-management workflows, and automated incident alerting.   
Scale Real-Time Analytics: Expand streaming feeds (Kafka/Flink/Pinot) to lower latency and power real-time operational notifications as incidents develop.   

What You’ll Need   
4–6 years in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or Data Engineering with a focus on dataset and pipeline ownership (not just query consumption).   
Advanced SQL & Distributed Computing: Hands-on experience building production transformations in Spark S

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst Remote Dehradun
jobs_results.description:
Role: Data Analyst (Remote)   
Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)   

Role Overview:   

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Business Analyst (Russian Language) to work on a full time basis. The ideal candidate must have strong analytical and comprehension skills, with the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks. The role involves conducting online research, validating claims, and collaborating with large language models to solve analytical puzzles.  

Key Responsibilities:   
Read and summarize extensive Russian‑language documents, dividing them into logical sections for model training.  
Conduct independent online research to verify factual statements presented in source material.  
Provide detailed annotations and constructive feedback to improve large language model outputs.  
Design scenario‑based puzzles that test model reasoning and generate corrective explanations.  
Analyze quantitative examples, such as sales distributions, to identify growth patterns and communicate findings.  
Work closely with AI engineers to integrate analytical insights into model fine‑tuning processes.  

Required Skills & Qualifications:   
Proficiency in reading and writing both English and Russian, demonstrating a high degree of comprehension.  
Robust analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with experience breaking complex information into actionable insights.  
Demonstrated research skills, including the ability to locate, assess, and validate information from online sources.  
Ability to deliver explicit, constructive feedback and detailed annotations that guide model improvement.  
Creative and lateral thinking to develop novel scenarios that challenge model performance.  

More About the Opportunity:   

This role provides the chance to work with a global leader in artificial intelligence, contributing to the fine‑tuning of large language models that support mission‑critical applications for enterprise customers.
